env.name: SESSION_SECRET
env.description: Long random string used to sign session cookies. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32. Without it, everyone is signed out on every restart.

env.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
env.description: OAuth client ID from Google Cloud Console (APIs & Services > Credentials). Leave unset to disable Google sign-in.

env.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: OAuth client secret from Google Cloud Console.

env.name: ALLOWED_EMAILS
env.description: Comma-separated Google accounts allowed to sign in. Leave empty to allow anyone with a Google account.
